user.title: Vegagerðin Road Conditions
user.description: Choose which kinds of entities this integration should create, then select only the roads, stations, cameras, and counters you want.

data.register_lovelace_card: Load route planner card on dashboards

data_description.language: Controls road section names, conditions, notices, and route alerts fetched from Vegagerðin.
data_description.enable_road_summaries: Adds road condition sensors and road warning binary sensors for selected road sections.
data_description.enable_weather_station_sensors: Adds temperature, wind, humidity, and traffic sensors for selected weather stations.
data_description.enable_traffic_counter_sensors: Adds traffic count sensors for selected traffic counters.
data_description.enable_cameras: Adds enabled camera entities for every image exposed by selected Vegagerðin webcam sites.
data_description.enable_route_sensors: Creates a route device for each selected destination with status, notices, cameras, and a problem indicator.
data_description.register_lovelace_card: Only enable this when using the custom route planner card in a Lovelace dashboard. The Road Routes sidebar panel does not need it.
data_description.osrm_url: Base URL for an OSRM driving router.
data_description.route_origin_entity_id: A zone, person, or tracker with coordinates. Home is the usual origin.
data_description.route_include_zones: Automatically adds stable route devices for every Home Assistant zone except the origin.
data_description.route_tracker_entity_ids: Trackers whose coordinates represent changing destinations, such as a vehicle navigation destination.
data_description.route_road_corridor_km: Maximum distance between the route and an official road-condition section.
data_description.route_point_corridor_km: Maximum distance from the route for weather stations, webcams, and traffic counters.

select.title: Select favorites
select.description: Nothing is selected automatically. Pick only the items you want Home Assistant to create.

data_description.road_condition_ids: Selected road sections create the basic road status and warning entities.
data_description.weather_station_ids: Selected stations are used by optional weather station sensors and detail actions.
data_description.camera_ids: Selected webcam sites create one camera entity per available image when camera entities are enabled.
data_description.traffic_counter_ids: Selected counters are used by optional traffic counter sensors and detail actions.
data_description.notice_region_keys: Selected regions create a dashboard-friendly regional notices sensor. Home and zone locations are suggested when possible.

coverage.title: Coverage suggestions
coverage.description: Choose an optional center and radii to pre-fill nearby roads, cameras, stations, and counters on the next page.

data_description.coverage_center: Use Home or an HA zone such as Work as the center for nearby suggestions.
data_description.road_condition_radius_km: Preselect road sections whose map center is within this radius. Use small values for this.
data_description.camera_radius_km: Preselect webcam sites within this radius.
data_description.weather_station_radius_km: Preselect weather stations within this radius.
data_description.traffic_counter_radius_km: Preselect traffic counters within this radius.

error.required: This field is required when route devices are enabled.
